[[Image:Moschovakis Schwichtenberg Troelstra.jpg|right|300px|thumb|Troelstra <small>(right)</small> with [[Helmut Schwichtenberg]] and [[Yiannis Moschovakis]] <small>(left)</small>, 2002.]]
'''Anne Sjerp Troelstra''' (10 August 1939 – 7 March 2019) was a professor of [[pure mathematics]] and [[foundations of mathematics]] at the [[Institute for Logic, Language and Computation]] (ILLC) of the [[University of Amsterdam]].

He was a [[Constructivism (mathematics)|constructivist]] [[logician]], who was influential in the development of [[intuitionistic logic]]<ref>[http://www.ozsl.uu.nl/MartinLob.html MARTIN LÖB (1921&ndash;2006)] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20061223222900/http://www.ozsl.uu.nl/MartinLob.html|date=23 December 2006}}</ref> With [[Georg Kreisel]], he was a developer of the theory of [[choice sequence]]s.<ref>{{Citation|first=Mathieu|last=Marion|title=Wittgenstein, Finitism, and the Foundations of Mathematics|year=1998|location=New York|publisher=Oxford University Press|page=205|isbn=0-19-823516-X }}</ref> He wrote one of the first texts on [[linear logic]],<ref>{{Citation|first=Herman Ruge|last=Jervell|title=Review: ''Lectures on Linear Logic'' by A. S. Troelstra|journal=Journal of Symbolic Logic|volume=61|issue=1|year=1996|pages=336–38|doi=10.2307/2275616|jstor=2275616|s2cid=117923544 }}</ref> and, with [[Helmut Schwichtenberg]], he co-wrote an important book on [[proof theory]].<ref>{{Citation|first=Roy|last=Dyckhoff|title=Review: ''Basic Proof Theory'' by A. S. Troelstra; H. Schwichtenberg|journal=Journal of Symbolic Logic|volume=63|issue=4|year=1998|pages=1605–06|doi=10.2307/2586674|jstor=2586674|s2cid=118433941 }}</ref>

He became a member of the [[Royal Netherlands Academy of Arts and Sciences]] in 1976.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.knaw.nl/en/members/members/4881 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160214194705/https://www.knaw.nl/en/members/members/4881|title=Anne Troelstra|publisher=Royal Netherlands Academy of Arts and Sciences|archive-date=14 February 2016|accessdate=14 February 2016}}</ref> Troelstra died on 7 March 2019.<ref>{{cite web|title=Anne Troelstra (1939-2019)|url=http://www.illc.uva.nl/NewsandEvents/News/Obituaries/Anne-Troelstra-1939-2019-|website=illc.uva.nl|accessdate=13 March 2019}}</ref>

After his retirement in 2000, Troelstra began a prolific career as the author of books on natural history travel, including the Bibliography of Natural History Travel Narratives, published with Brill in 2017. There are many others in Dutch, including Tijgers op de Ararat. Natuurhistorische reisverhalen 1700-1950 (Tigers on the Ararat. Natural History Travel Narratives 1700-1950), Van Spitsbergen naar Suriname (From Spitsbergen to Surinam).
